purpose: Teach: 悪党/対局/貧血/中性/土砂/憂い/ぞっと/手遅れ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療現場では、本気で、絶対、悪党、絶対、と、絶対、呼べる、絶対、ような、絶対、振る舞いの患者さん、絶対、本当に、絶対、稀ですよ、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, you know—in medical practice, patients who truly behave in ways you'd call absolutely villainous are genuinely rare. I'm grateful for that.
lines.style: Steady, clear delivery. Slight pause after the name, as if choosing words carefully. Warm but measured. A hint of relief in the observation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療界での、本気で、絶対、対局、絶対、的な、絶対、治療法、絶対、議論、絶対、続いていますか、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Professor, do opposing treatment philosophies still come up often in the medical field?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity. Soft, thoughtful pace. Leaning slightly forward—not performing interest, but actually wanting to understand. No rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの、本気で、絶対、貧血、絶対、改善、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're making steady progress on improving the patient's anemia across the whole team.
lines.style: Clear, direct statement of fact. Confident without being proud. The tone of someone reporting progress as it is, without embellishment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 消毒液の、本気で、絶対、中性、絶対、と、絶対、酸性、絶対、使い分け、絶対、医療現場、絶対、徹底されているんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So disinfectant protocols—neutral versus acidic solutions—those distinctions are really carefully maintained in practice, aren't they?
lines.style: Asking as though testing his own understanding. Attentive, slightly hesitant. Building on what he's learned. A student checking in with himself as much as the teacher.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。豪雨の、本気で、絶対、土砂、絶対、災害、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、ご支援、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. During that heavy rain and landslide, our team was able to provide medical support to the affected area.
lines.style: Quiet, factual. No drama in the delivery—just stating what was done. A hint of quiet satisfaction underneath the professionalism.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんのご家族の、本気で、絶対、憂い、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、寄り添って、絶対、いらっしゃるんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The medical team really does stand close to families when they're carrying that weight of worry, doesn't it?
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Almost a gentle observation rather than a question. Noticing something human. Slow enough to let it land.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの、本気で、絶対、急変、絶対、ぞっと、絶対、する場面、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、対応、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When a patient's condition shifts suddenly—those moments where you feel a chill—we're rigorous about our response protocols.
lines.style: Calm but serious. Emphasis on the word for 'rigorous,' with quiet conviction. The tone of someone who has lived those moments and learned from them.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療が、本気で、絶対、手遅れ、絶対、にならぬよう、絶対、医療チームの、絶対、迅速対応、絶対、本当にありがたいですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: It's really something to be grateful for—the team's swift response, so that treatment never comes too late.
lines.style: Warm, reflective close. Gentle pace. The gratitude is genuine and understated. Trailing slightly, like an exhale of relief.
